title: Add persistent PDF download and reset functionality

requirements.text: After checklist submission, display a 'Download PDF' button that allows the user to manually download the generated PDF

quotes: after submitting the checklist there will be a download pdf button user will download the pdf manually

acceptanceCriteria: A 'Download PDF' button appears after successful checklist submission
Clicking the button triggers a PDF download
The button remains visible and functional after download

requirements.text: Keep the PDF download button visible and functional on the website until the user explicitly clicks a Reset button

quotes: it will stay on the website as long as the user clicks on a button Reset

acceptanceCriteria: The Download PDF button persists after first download
User can click Download PDF multiple times without resubmitting
The button only disappears when Reset is clicked

requirements.text: Add a 'Reset' button that clears the checklist, removes the PDF download button, and allows the user to start a new checklist submission

quotes: user clicks on a button Reset to reset the checklist so that user can download the pdf as many times as he wants

acceptanceCriteria: A 'Reset' button is visible when the PDF download button is shown
Clicking Reset clears all form data including store name, checkboxes, and photos
Clicking Reset hides the PDF download button and returns to the initial form state
After reset, user can submit a new checklist and generate a new PDF

constraints: Maintain neumorphic design system for all new UI elements
Preserve existing per-item photo capture functionality
Keep PDF generation client-side using the existing pdfGenerator utility
nonGoals: PDF history or multiple PDF management
Automatic PDF download without user interaction
